title: "Never Quit - Such a dangerous team" - Moeen Ali Post Match Interview | WI vs ENG, 2nd T20
quote_text:
"I think the great thing about today is even though they were 50/5, six, seven down for not many runs they are never quite out of the game and they're such a dangerous team with plays I know they have admit they've a lot of older players have retired and stuff but they've got so much talent so much power the fact that they back all the way down to number 10 makes them extremely dangerous even in the situation where we thought we probably gonna cruise that game in the end but for them to lose by one run or whatever it was is it's actually quite scary they're batting around if it's very scary"
